  - /vol1/maint/docs/control_plane/proof_ledger.v0.json

1. ops/scripts/chief_collect_evidence_bundle.py: read-only CLI that accepts named workspace issue refs and local artifact paths, then emits a sanitized JSON bundle.

- Do not use OpenClaw.

- python3 -m json.tool docs/control_plane/evidence_bundle.schema.json and sample bundle pass.

- sample bundle includes issue snapshots/comments/runs for ASF-25, AOP-70, AOP-71, AOP-72 and local artifact refs for ASF-25 files.
- grep/static inspection shows no mutating Multica commands in the script.
